entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to arrange a return for an order. I bought a pair of cycling shoes about a month ago, and they're just not working out for me.

I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a sizing or comfort preference?

It's a comfort issue. A major one. No matter what I do, they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I've tried adjusting the cleats, wearing different socks, everything, but they're just not the right fit for my feet.
Oh, that sounds very uncomfortable. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered on December 3rd. That was 33 days ago. One moment while I check our policy.
Alright, I've checked for you. Our standard items fall under our 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I will need to buy a different pair, and given the trouble with these, is there any chance of getting a small discount code for my next purchase?

That's a reasonable question. Let me see what I can do. I see here that you're a long-time VeloFit VIP member. As a thank you for your loyalty, I can definitely offer you complimentary return shipping for these shoes, and I can also email you a 15% discount code to use on your next pair. How does that sound?

That sounds perfect, Sarah. That's exactly what I was hoping for. It makes the process of finding the right cycling shoes a lot less painful. I'll get these packed up and sent back once I receive the label.

Excellent. I've just initiated the return and sent the free shipping label to your email on file. Your discount code will be in a separate email. Once we receive the shoes, we'll process your full refund. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find you a pair of shoes that work much better. Have a great day!
